The '''CV14-B Concussion Vest''' was a type of personal [[Armor/Legends|armor]] manufactured by [[Core World Arms]]. Individual helmets cost 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and they protected the wearer from physical injury.<ref name="TotJC" />
